Everyday habits that
make you smarter over time
Ask "why" more often. At work, in the news, in conversations. Looking for causes trains deeper thinking every single day.
Read before bed instead of scrolling. Twenty pages a night adds up to dozens of books a year. Keep a book on your pillow so it's the first thing you see.
Explain what you learned to a friend. Teaching forces you to really understand and helps you remember it for years. Share one idea a week.
Try new routes and new places. Exploring keeps your brain alert and builds better memory and orientation. Change one route this week.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. Small daily lessons build real knowledge over months.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Small daily lessons build real knowledge over months.

slides.texte_overlay: Take notes on what matters. A small notebook for ideas, quotes and lessons. Writing helps you think and remember. Keep it in your pocket.
Rest your mind properly. Sleep, walks and quiet time are when your brain sorts and stores what you learned. Don't skip it.
